Console字号需在10–24之间: Console font size must be between 10 and 24
Console行距需在1–1.8之间: Console line spacing must be between 1 and 1.8

仅显示包含关键词的日志行: Show only log lines containing the keyword
仅显示最近输出；日志文件也有保留上限: Recent output only; log files also have retention limits
保留原脚本文件和日志。: The source file and logs will be kept.
关闭搜索，恢复完整视图: Close search and restore the full view
分组名称不能包含换行或控制字符: Group name cannot contain line breaks or control characters
启动文件有未保存的编辑，请先保存或关闭再删除/变更源文件: Save or close the unsaved launch file before deleting it or changing its source
回退会保留当前版本，下次启动使用回退后的文件。: The current version will be kept. The next launch will use the restored file.
在当前保留的最近日志中搜索，按 Enter / Shift+Enter 跳转: Search retained output; use Enter / Shift+Enter to navigate
在标签视图中打开当前 Console: Open this console in a tab
双击在标签视图中打开: Double-click to open in tab view
已运行，可停止或重启: Already running; stop or restart it
应用菜单必须在主线程创建: The application menu must be created on the main thread
当前图形后端不支持独立 Console 窗口: Detached console windows are not supported by this graphics backend
文件已关闭，可从左侧历史重新打开: File closed. Reopen it from the sidebar history.
文件已被外部修改；请重新载入，当前草稿仍保留: The file changed externally. Reload it; your draft has been kept.
文件有未保存修改，请先保存或明确放弃: This file has unsaved changes. Save or discard them first.
无法静态确定启动端口，且尚未确认实际监听；可在启动清单中声明 expected_: No configured port or confirmed listener; declare expected_port in the launch configuration
点击列名切换排序方向: Click a column heading to toggle its sort direction
确认停止服务并关闭窗口吗？: Stop this service and close this window?
确认停止服务并关闭此标签吗？: Stop this service and close this tab?
显示名需要 1–50 个字符，且不能包含换行或控制字符: Display name must contain 1–50 characters without line breaks or control characters
有启动文件尚未保存。: Some launch files have unsaved changes.
欢迎提出建议，也欢迎捐赠支持。: Your feedback and donations are welcome.
界面字号需在10–18之间: Interface font size must be between 10 and 18
相同命令和参数的启动项已存在: A launch with the same command and arguments already exists
系统应用菜单尚未创建: The system application menu is not ready
调整工作台和 Console 的阅读体验: Customize the workspace and console reading experience
选择一个启动文件开始编辑: Choose a launch file to start editing
配置仍有运行实例，请先停止并确认退出: This configuration has a running instance. Stop it and wait for it to exit first.
项目名称不能包含换行或控制字符: Project name cannot contain line breaks or control characters
默认分组不可删除: The default group cannot be deleted
切换会更新整个仓库的文件，关联项目也会受到影响。请先停止依赖这些文件的服务；有未: Switching updates files throughout the repository, including associated projects. Stop services that depend on these files first. Uncommitted changes will prevent switching.
在当前仓库执行 Git 命令，不支持 shell 管道。: Runs Git in this repository. Shell pipelines are not supported.
恢复到 HEAD，覆盖此文件的工作区和暂存区改动。DevStart 会先保存备份: Restore this file to HEAD, replacing its working tree and staged changes. DevStart saves a backup first.
将本地提交推送到当前分支配置的远程上游，不强制覆盖。: Push local commits to the configured upstream without force.
拉取远程更新并合并到当前分支。发生冲突时保留冲突供手动处理。: Fetch and merge into the current branch. Conflicts remain available for manual resolution.
从当前远程仓库当前分支获取最新版本与本地合并代码: Fetch the latest version of the current branch from the selected remote and merge it into the local branch.
将本地提交推送到所选远程仓库的当前分支，不强制覆盖。: Push local commits to the current branch of the selected remote without force.
合并提交：相对第一父提交: Merge commit: compared with its first parent
初始提交：相对空目录: Initial commit: compared with the empty tree
相对父提交的改动: Changes compared with the parent commit
双击文件查看本次提交的差异: Double-click a file to view this commit’s diff
本次提交没有文件改动: This commit has no file changes
切换后，更新和推送将使用所选地址。此操作不修改 Git 远程配置。: Updates and pushes will use the selected address. Git remote configuration is unchanged.
适合 AI Coding 时代的多项目启动工作台。: A multi-project launch workbench for the AI Coding era.
需要相关服务时，找到对应项目、点击启动，再切回当前项目。项目依赖与启动顺序由你掌: Need a related service? Find its project, click to start it, then switch back. You choose the dependencies and launch order.
项目多也不乱。快速找到项目，启动、停止、看日志，再切回手头的工作。: More projects. Less friction. Find a project, start or stop it, check its logs, and get back to your work.
已达到扫描上限，部分目录未扫描。请选择更具体的目录继续扫描。: Scan limit reached. Some directories were not scanned. Choose a more specific directory.
发现 {count} 个项目，勾选需要添加的启动项: Found {count} projects. Select launch entries to add.
自动扫描识别项目与启动项: Automatically discover projects and launch entries
确认添加所选项目与启动项到以下分组？: Add the selected projects and launch entries to this group?
分支未切换。请处理以下问题后重试；本地修改不会被强制丢弃。: Branch unchanged. Resolve the issue below and retry; local changes will not be forcibly discarded.
切换会更新实际项目文件，关联项目也会受到影响。无冲突的本地修改会保留；冲突时将取: Switching updates the actual project files and affects related projects. Non-conflicting local changes are preserved; conflicts cancel the switch with an explanation.
未跟踪目录会将其中所有未跟踪文件纳入本次提交: Selecting this untracked folder includes all its files in the commit
未跟踪目录不能作为单个文件预览；选择后提交会包含其中全部文件: Untracked folders can't be previewed as a single file; committing the selection includes all files in the folder
未跟踪目录没有 HEAD 版本，无法回滚。: Untracked folders have no HEAD version to restore.
先解决冲突文件后再更新或提交: Resolve conflicts before updating or committing
先解决合并冲突，再生成提交备注: Resolve merge conflicts before generating a commit message
请至少选择一个非冲突文件生成提交备注: Select at least one file without conflicts to generate a commit message
更新会对未解决冲突采用远程版本；原本地改动保留在 Git stash 中: Update resolves conflicts using the remote version and keeps the original local changes in Git stash
自动暂存恢复发生冲突；本地改动仍保存在 Git stash 中。冲突文件：{fi: Applying the autostash caused conflicts. Local changes remain in Git stash. Conflicted files: {files}
冲突文件需先解决，不能直接回滚: Resolve this conflict before restoring the file
此文件不支持查看预览: Preview is not supported for this file.
请先关闭当前 Diff 窗口，再查看其他文件。: Close the current Diff window before viewing another file.
未跟踪文件没有 HEAD 版本，无法撤销恢复。: Untracked files have no HEAD version to restore.
撤销此文件的工作区和暂存区修改，恢复到 HEAD 版本；操作前保存备份，点击后需: Restore this file’s working tree and index to HEAD. A backup is saved first, and confirmation is required.
选择来源与目标分支，在本地仓库执行合并: Select source and destination branches to merge locally
操作会切换到目标分支并合并，不会推送远程。冲突将保留供处理。: This switches to the destination branch and merges locally without pushing. Conflicts remain for resolution.
确认要把这个版本恢复为本地最新版本吗？: Restore this version as the latest local version?
将生成新的本地恢复提交，保留历史，不修改远程。之后需自行推送以同步远程。: Creates a new local restore commit, preserving history and leaving the remote unchanged. Push separately to synchronize.
将所选历史版本恢复为当前分支的最新本地提交，不修改远程；执行前需确认: Restore this historical version as a new local commit on the current branch. The remote is unchanged; confirmation is required.
Git 操作进行中，请稍候再回滚文件。: A Git operation is running. Wait before restoring the file.
使用已安装并登录的本地命令行工具；自动选择并记住会保存首次成功的工具，自动模式每: Use an installed and signed-in local CLI. Detect once remembers the first successful tool; Automatic checks again each time.
生成工具设置保存失败: Could not save the generation tool preference
备注已被修改，生成结果未覆盖当前内容: The message was edited; the generated result did not replace it
使用本地 AI 工具根据勾选文件生成提交备注，不会提交代码: Generate a commit message from selected files using a local AI tool. This does not commit code.
请先勾选需要提交的文件，并等待当前任务完成: Select files to commit and wait for the current task to finish
勾选的文件将包含在本次提交中: Selected files will be included in this commit
正在使用本地 AI 工具生成提交备注…: Generating a commit message with a local AI tool…
选中或取消所有分组中的全部文件，包括已收起的分组: Select or deselect all files across every group, including collapsed groups
选中或取消本分组的全部文件: Select or deselect all files in this group
目标分支 {target} 将接收 {source} 的提交并更新本地文件，必要: Destination {target} receives commits from {source} and updates local files, creating a merge commit if needed.
操作后停留在 {target} 分支；同一仓库的其他项目也会看到文件变化。: The working tree stays on {target}; other projects in the same repository also see the file changes.
不推送远程，远程分支保持不变。若有冲突，将保留现场供手动处理。: No push is performed; remote branches remain unchanged. Conflicts are left for manual resolution.
合并分支不能两个相同的分支合并: Cannot merge a branch into itself. Choose two different branches.
重新扫描更新项目启动脚本: Rescan group projects and launch scripts
仅移除分组及其中项目、启动项在 DevStart 的登记。不会删除项目目录或源文: Remove only DevStart registrations for this group, its projects and launch items. Project directories and source files are kept.
分组项目与启动项已更新: Group projects and launch items updated
扫描期间配置已变化，请重新扫描: Configuration changed during scanning. Scan again.
如有关联运行实例，将先优雅停止，超时后强制关闭，再删除登记。: Associated instances will be stopped gracefully, then force-closed if needed, before registrations are removed.
正在停止关联实例并删除分组…: Stopping associated instances and removing the group…
仅移除项目及其启动项在 DevStart 的登记。不会删除项目目录或源文件。: Remove only this project and its launch registrations from DevStart. Project directories and source files are kept.
正在停止关联实例并移除登记…: Stopping associated instances and removing registrations…
关闭实例期间配置已变化，请重新执行删除: Configuration changed while stopping instances. Retry removal.
在当前项目目录执行命令: Run commands in this project directory
请先解决冲突并完成当前操作: Resolve conflicts and finish the current operation first
合并远程提交，必要时创建合并提交。: Merge remote commits, creating a merge commit when needed.
把本地提交重新应用到远程最新提交之后，会改写本地提交哈希。: Replay local commits onto the latest remote commit, changing local commit hashes.
本地未提交改动会先保存并在更新后恢复；冲突由你确认处理。: Uncommitted changes are saved and restored after updating. Conflicts require your review.
Rebase 会改写当前分支的本地提交哈希。已共享的提交应谨慎变基；推送仍不会强: Rebase changes local commit hashes. Use care with shared commits; Push does not force overwrite the remote.
远程分支有新提交。选择更新方式，成功后重试推送；未提交文件不会被自动提交。: The remote has new commits. Choose an update method, then retry Push. Uncommitted files will not be committed automatically.
选择一侧完整版本，或直接编辑中间结果；应用后仅暂存该文件，点击继续完成操作。: Choose a whole version or edit the middle result. Apply stages this file; Continue finishes the operation.
此版本已删除文件，或文件为二进制/过大，无法显示文本。: This version deletes the file or is binary/too large to display.
确认已检查并手动恢复本地改动？恢复副本会继续保留在 Git stash 中，此操: Have you inspected and manually restored your local changes? The stash backup is retained; this only ends recovery mode.
终止当前 Merge/Rebase，恢复到操作前的分支状态，并尝试恢复已保存的本: Abort the current Merge/Rebase, restore the previous branch state, and restore saved local changes.
提交选中文件，然后推送已有提交。: Commit selected files, then push existing commits.
确认跳过当前正在重放的提交？该提交在此次 Rebase 中的改动将被丢弃，之后继: Skip the commit currently being replayed? Its changes are discarded from this rebase, which then continues with later commits.
勾选目录会将其中所有未跟踪文件纳入本次提交: Selecting a directory includes all its untracked files in this commit
无法确定启动项端口: Cannot determine the launch item port
请先勾选需要提交的文件并填写提交备注: Select files and enter a commit message first
仅忽略未跟踪文件或目录，向 .gitignore 添加精确路径；已跟踪文件不会取: Ignore an untracked file or directory using an exact .gitignore rule. Tracked files remain tracked.
请填写提交备注或生成备注。: Enter a commit message or generate one.
请等待当前任务完成: Wait for the current operation to finish
从 Git 索引移除，保留本地文件。下次提交将记录移除跟踪。: Remove from the Git index and keep the local file. The next commit records the removal.
